item.title: Amaenbo Fuyu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: DojinOtome
  • 発売日: 2023-07-14
  • スコア: 8.15/10 (386 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あまえんぼ冬
  • 英語名: Amaenbo Fuyu

别名

  • Amaenbo Fuyu

あらすじ

After the unforgettable summer memories you’ve made half a year ago, Yui, Rio, and Miyuki are back. With the change of seasons and the cold falling snow, a new page to your story is about to begin.

Revisit the peaceful, seaside town, and spend time catching up with your family and friends.

item.title: Amaenbo ~Sei o Osaekirenai Boku to Mushou no Oyako~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: DojinOtome
  • 発売日: 2019-09-10
  • スコア: 7.8/10 (920 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あまえんぼ 性を抑えきれない僕と無償の親子
  • 英語名: Amaenbo Sei o Osaekirenai Boku to Mushou no Oyako

别名

  • Amaenbo Sei o Osaekirenai Boku to Mushou no Oyako

あらすじ

Summer break has begun, and for the first time in years, you’re going back to the countryside to visit your family. At first, it doesn’t seem like there’s much to do so far from the city, but you’ll soon find there’s more to this quiet mountain village than meets the eye!
